title: How a vaccine trains your body

beats.say: A vaccine trains your immune system before the real virus ever arrives.
beats.label: Training, not fighting

beats.say: It carries only a harmless piece of the virus, like a photo of a suspect.
beats.label: A harmless piece

beats.say: Your immune cells study that piece and build antibodies that fit it.
beats.label: Antibodies that fit

beats.say: When the real virus shows up, your body can recognise it at once.
beats.label: Ready for the real virus

beats.say: Show a harmless piece, build matching antibodies, and remember them for years.
beats.label: Three steps

beats.say: That memory is why one small shot can protect you.
beats.label: Protected
